7076. city of Niksic. A one-story house with an area of 112 sq. m: a corridor, two bedrooms, a kitchen, a living room, a small room - an office. The house is being sold unfurnished (tenants' furniture and equipment will be removed upon eviction). The plot is 540 sq. m. There are additional buildings on it: a garage - 18 sq. m., an auxiliary room - 15 sq. m. In the yard there is a garden, parking. Good location - 1300 meters from the city center, Trebisha National Park - 270 meters. Full infrastructure, city communications. The house has no restrictions, no legalization is required. Niksic is the second largest city in Montenegro: schools, children's institutions, a branch of the University of Podgorica. The capital Podgorica is 65 km, the ski resort Zabljak is 84 km, the sea is 105 km. In the area (3-8 km) there are large fish lakes. The cost of the house with a plot is 49,999 euros, payment in Montenegro.
